biggest_catch: You must spend $15,000 on purchases in the first 90 days after account opening to earn the $1,000 bonus rewards - that is ~$5,000/month of real business spend; never spend extra solely to chase the bonus. The $299 annual fee is waived for the first year (and each year you spend $100,000+), so the first-year net is the full $1,000.
catches: Never spend extra solely to chase the $1,000 bonus; $15,000 in 90 days must be normal business spending you would do anyway.

$299 annual fee is waived for the first year (and waived each year you spend $100,000+); first-year net value of the bonus is the full $1,000, but later years cost $299 unless the waiver spend is met.
Applying for a credit card can involve a hard inquiry on your credit report.
If you carry a balance, interest (15.74% - 24.74% variable APR) can erase the bonus; pay in full each month.
Only new business cardholders qualify for the welcome bonus; existing/previous account terms may exclude you - check eligibility when you apply.

Use the new card for $15,000 in purchases within the first 90 days after account opening - only normal business spending, never extra spend for the bonus.
